name: OPSD-FR-mp
notes: ENTSO-E FR system load (OPSD time_series 60min, FR_load_actual_entsoe_transparency) + ERA5 weather (Open-Meteo). aux column holds the TSO's own published day-ahead load forecast (FR_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency, coverage 100.0%). exogenous-series rules: (1) a solar/wind series is dropped if its raw data has any single internal gap longer than 720 h (30 d); (2) then dropped if <50% present over the load span (v1). generation columns kept: {'solar': 'FR_solar_generation_actual (max internal gap 5 h)', 'wind': 'FR_wind_onshore_generation_actual (max internal gap 5 h)'}. dropped: [none]. span start trimmed from 2015-01-01 01:00:00 (first load row) to 2015-01-01 08:00:00 (first fully observed row). missing cells interpolated: 51 (per channel {'load': 41, 'solar': 5, 'wind': 5}; linear up to 6 h, then ffill/bfill). MULTI-POINT WEATHER VARIANT (revision 2026-10-19): the four weather channels are the population-weighted mean of ERA5 at 6 metropolitan areas (Paris 12.3M, Lyon 2.3M, Marseille 1.8M, Toulouse 1.4M, Lille 1.2M, Bordeaux 1.3M); 0 cells interpolated; every other column identical to OPSD-FR.
